ModMetaData.name: Fused Ribbons
ModMetaData.author: Kid Monkey
ModMetaData.description:
Fuses the colonist tabs into one bottom-bar button with a ribbon (Work, Schedule, Assign, and Mechs if Biotech is active). Fuses Animals and Wildlife into a second ribbon. Other main buttons can be assigned to those rows, hidden, or given a new bar from the mod settings. (Restart Required)
The real tabs are opened, not copied, for compatability reasons. Hotkeys for those buttons are left alone.
Yes, I know about the "h" in the worktab. We tried. It is a feature, not a bug. The last work column clips its own header. Use a work-tab mod such as "Better Work Tab" or "Compact Work Tab (Continued)" to fix it.
The Wildlife cog is still there with "Grouped Pawns Lists". Minimize some of the headers to clear the rows and it should reappear.
